# AI SENSE

> Free public REST API and MCP tools for agents, scripts and small services.

AI SENSE AS publishes developer tools at aisenseapi.com. The public tools work without an account or API key.

## Start here

- Website: https://aisense.no/
- REST API catalog: https://aisense.no/free-public-apis
- MCP guide: https://aisense.no/free-public-mcp-server
- Source and documentation: https://github.com/aisenseapi/aisense-free-public-rest-apis

## MCP

- Remote server: https://aisenseapi.com/mcp
- Server metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aisenseapi/aisense-free-public-rest-apis/refs/heads/main/server.json
- Protocol guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aisenseapi/aisense-free-public-rest-apis/refs/heads/main/MCP.md
- Agent skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aisenseapi/aisense-free-public-rest-apis/refs/heads/main/SKILL.md

The MCP server exposes public workflow tools and a read-only Verifyum product resource. Verifyum proof creation writes a real Solana transaction. Use it only after clear user intent.

Agent Wake creates a durable MCP task that completes after a webhook, human answer or time event. It uses the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension with MCP revision 2026-07-28. REST clients can use the same task model at https://aisenseapi.com/services/v1/agent_wake.

## REST API

- Base URL: https://aisenseapi.com/services/v1
- API guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aisenseapi/aisense-free-public-rest-apis/refs/heads/main/API.md
- Agent Wake guide: https://aisense.no/free-public-api-agent-wake-api-endpoint

## Products

- AI SENSE: https://aisense.no/
- Verifyum: https://verifyum.com/
- Verifyum Witness Layer: https://verifyum.com/witness
- AI Data Feed: https://data.aisenseapi.com/

Verifyum's Witness Layer uses nine evidence records for checkpoints created since 2026-09-01. One finalized Solana Mainnet Memo transaction per proof is the primary evidence. Hourly OpenTimestamps on Bitcoin, a daily qualified EU timestamp, daily witness-cosigned Sigsum and a daily Certificate Transparency certificate provide independent corroboration. Glasklar, Mullvad and Tillitis cosign the Sigsum digest with a quorum of two out of three. The Verifyum signature, GitHub checkpoint log, Software Heritage and Internet Archive are operator records or availability redundancy. A Verifyum user proof is not a qualified electronic timestamp. Individual channel states can be pending, confirmed, unavailable or failed. The number of channels is not a quality score.
Verifyum announcements: https://t.me/verifyum
Verifyum Atom feed: https://verifyum.com/feed.xml
Announcement timestamps date the announcement. They say nothing about the original file date.
